properties.description: Suspends one exact workload instance; Resume fails closed with 422 before mutation until tenant evidence proves terminal semantics. Select an intersight.endpoint target whose default runtime user can read and PATCH the required workload objects. Names are OData-escaped, Moid-scoped, and must resolve exactly once. Suspend is allowed only from Ok. PATCH sends only Action; the generic API editor has no supported conditional-header binding, so the lookup/PATCH race remains. Validated ModTime is retained only as response and polling evidence, not as a precondition. HTTP 2xx proves acceptance only, and HTTP 412 is reported without assuming its cause. Non-wait requires response action evidence; wait succeeds only on Suspended. Unknown state, timeout, or ambiguous failure requires inspection. Replace generic APIs with a supported lifecycle atomic when available.

import json
import sys

status = "helper-failure"
statusCode = "500"
statusMessage = "Lifecycle input preparation did not complete"
errorMessage = "Lifecycle input preparation failed."
resultJson = json.dumps({"error":errorMessage}, separators=(",", ":"))
escapedOrganization = ""
escapedDeployment = ""
escapedInstance = ""
requestedAction = ""
waitForCompletion = False
waitTimeoutSeconds = 0
requestBody = "{}"

def as_bool(value):
    normalized = str(value).strip().lower()
    if normalized in {"true", "1", "yes"}:
        return True
    if normalized in {"false", "0", "no"}:
        return False
    raise ValueError("A boolean input was not serialized as true or false.")

try:
    organization = sys.argv[9]
    deployment = sys.argv[10]
    instance = sys.argv[11]
    actionInput = sys.argv[12]
    waitForCompletion = as_bool(sys.argv[16])
    waitTimeoutSeconds = int(sys.argv[17])
    confirmation = as_bool(sys.argv[18])
    mode = sys.argv[8]
    if not organization or not deployment or not instance:
        raise ValueError("Workload Organization, Workload Deployment Name, and Workload Instance Name must each be non-empty.")
    allowed = {
        "deploy-retry": {"Deploy", "Retry"},
        "suspend-resume": {"Suspend", "Resume"},
        "attach-detach": {"Attach", "Detach"},
        "unassign": {"UnAssign"},
    }
    if mode not in allowed or actionInput not in allowed[mode]:
        raise ValueError("Action does not exactly match an allowed API action for this workflow.")
    if mode == "attach-detach" and actionInput == "Detach" and not confirmation:
        raise ValueError("Confirm Detach must be true before Detach can be evaluated.")
    if mode == "unassign" and not confirmation:
        raise ValueError("Confirm Unassign must be true before UnAssign can be evaluated.")
    if waitForCompletion and (waitTimeoutSeconds < 1 or waitTimeoutSeconds > 1800):
        raise ValueError("Wait Timeout Seconds must be from 1 through 1800 when waiting is enabled.")
    if not waitForCompletion and waitTimeoutSeconds < 0:
        raise ValueError("Wait Timeout Seconds cannot be negative.")
    escapedOrganization = sys.argv[13]
    escapedDeployment = sys.argv[14]
    escapedInstance = sys.argv[15]
    requestedAction = actionInput
    requestBody = json.dumps({"Action":requestedAction}, separators=(",", ":"))
    status = "ok"
    statusCode = "200"
    statusMessage = "Lifecycle inputs validated and OData literals escaped"
    errorMessage = ""
    resultJson = json.dumps({"inputValidation":"passed","requestedAction":requestedAction,"waitForCompletion":waitForCompletion}, separators=(",", ":"))
except ValueError as exc:
    status = "invalid"
    statusCode = "400"
    statusMessage = "Lifecycle input validation failed"
    errorMessage = str(exc)
    resultJson = json.dumps({"error":errorMessage}, separators=(",", ":"))
except Exception as exc:
    status = "helper-failure"
    statusCode = "500"
    statusMessage = "Lifecycle input preparation helper failed"
    errorMessage = str(exc)
    resultJson = json.dumps({"error":"Lifecycle input preparation helper failed","detail":errorMessage}, separators=(",", ":"))

properties.description: Revalidates exact identity, LastAction, ModTime, Status, and AssignedResources. Unknown states fail closed; only schema-backed terminal rules can succeed. Preserves HTTP 300-599 and bounded allowlisted Code/Message on API failure; malformed/transport failures remain 502.

properties.script:
import json
import sys

status = "helper-failure"
statusCode = "500"
statusMessage = "Action-state inspection did not complete"
errorMessage = "Action-state inspection failed."
resultJson = json.dumps({"error":errorMessage}, separators=(",", ":"))
decision = "unsafe"

import re
try:
    upstreamStatus = int(sys.argv[9])
except (ValueError, TypeError):
    upstreamStatus = 0
requestSucceeded = sys.argv[10].strip().lower() == "true"
if not requestSucceeded or not 200 <= upstreamStatus < 300:
    status = "api-failure"
    statusCode = str(upstreamStatus if 300 <= upstreamStatus < 600 else 502)
    statusMessage = "Intersight API request failed"
    errorMessage = "The Intersight request failed. Inspect the exact instance before retrying an uncertain mutation."
    safeCode, safeMessage = "", ""
    try:
        payload = json.loads(sys.argv[1])
        code = payload.get("Code", "") if isinstance(payload, dict) else ""
        detail = payload.get("Message", "") if isinstance(payload, dict) else ""
        if isinstance(code, str) and re.fullmatch(r"[A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{1,128}", code):
            safeCode = code
        if isinstance(detail, str) and re.fullmatch(r"[A-Za-z0-9 _.,:()/+\-]{1,500}", detail) and not re.search(r"authorization|password|secret|token|api.?key|bearer|https?://", detail, re.IGNORECASE):
            safeMessage = detail
    except Exception:
        pass
    if safeMessage:
        errorMessage = safeMessage
    resultJson = json.dumps({"status":"api-failure", "upstreamStatus":upstreamStatus, "Code":safeCode, "Message":safeMessage}, separators=(",", ":"))
else:
    try:
        item = json.loads(sys.argv[1])
        expectedMoid = sys.argv[2]
        expectedName = sys.argv[3]
        action = sys.argv[4]
        preStatus = sys.argv[5]
        preModTime = sys.argv[6]
        mode = sys.argv[7]
        attempt = int(sys.argv[8])
        if not isinstance(item, dict):
            raise ValueError("The polled response body is not a JSON object.")
        currentStatus = item.get("Status")
        currentModTime = item.get("ModTime")
        lastAction = item.get("LastAction")
        assigned = item.get("AssignedResources")
        if assigned is None:
            assigned = []
        validIdentity = item.get("Moid") == expectedMoid and item.get("Name") == expectedName and item.get("ObjectType") == "workload.WorkloadInstance"
        if not validIdentity or not isinstance(currentStatus, str) or not currentStatus or not isinstance(currentModTime, str) or not isinstance(assigned, list):
            raise ValueError("The polled workload instance failed exact identity or required-state validation.")
        evidence = lastAction == action and (currentModTime != preModTime or currentStatus != preStatus)
        if mode == "deploy-retry":
            if evidence and currentStatus == "Ok":
                decision = "success"
            elif evidence and currentStatus == "Failed":
                decision = "failure"
            elif evidence and currentStatus in {"InSufficientResource", "OutOfService"}:
                decision = "blocked"
            elif currentStatus in {preStatus, "Staging", "ReadyToDeploy", "InProgress", "ChangesScheduled"}:
                decision = "pending"
            else:
                decision = "unsafe"
        elif mode == "suspend-resume":
            if evidence and action == "Suspend" and currentStatus == "Suspended":
                decision = "success"
            elif evidence and currentStatus == "Failed":
                decision = "failure"
            elif evidence and currentStatus in {"InSufficientResource", "OutOfService"}:
                decision = "blocked"
            elif currentStatus in {preStatus, "InProgress", "ChangesScheduled"}:
                decision = "pending"
            else:
                decision = "unsafe"
        elif mode == "unassign":
            if evidence and action == "UnAssign" and currentStatus != "UnAssigning" and len(assigned) == 0:
                decision = "success"
            elif evidence and currentStatus == "Failed":
                decision = "failure"
            else:
                decision = "pending"
        else:
            raise ValueError("Unknown lifecycle polling mode.")
        status = "ok" if decision != "unsafe" else "invalid"
        statusCode = "200" if decision != "unsafe" else "502"
        statusMessage = "Workload-instance action state inspected" if decision != "unsafe" else "Workload-instance action entered an unrecognized or unsafe state"
        errorMessage = "" if decision != "unsafe" else "Polling stopped fail-closed because the observed state is outside the schema-backed decision rules for this action."
        resultJson = json.dumps({
            "requestAccepted":True,
            "Moid":expectedMoid,
            "Name":expectedName,
            "requestedAction":action,
            "LastAction":lastAction,
            "preActionStatus":preStatus,
            "Status":currentStatus,
            "preActionModTime":preModTime,
            "ModTime":currentModTime,
            "AssignedResourceCount":len(assigned),
            "actionEvidence":evidence,
            "pollAttempt":attempt,
            "decision":decision
        }, separators=(",", ":"))
    except Exception as exc:
        status = "helper-failure"
        statusCode = "500"
        statusMessage = "Action-state inspection helper failed"
        errorMessage = str(exc)
        resultJson = json.dumps({"error":"Action-state inspection failed","detail":errorMessage,"requestAccepted":True}, separators=(",", ":"))
